responses.raw_text: {"decisions":[{"raw_theme_id":"RT_6A9D838E8BE7","assigned_cluster_id":"C3","justification":"The claim is that eating decisions are made in the moment by flexibly reacting to whatever options are immediately at hand rather than by plan."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_C69B6F22B333","assigned_cluster_id":"C10","justification":"It asserts that convenient app-based ordering displaces socialising lies in the ability to hold genuine conversation, which is the core of shared-meal connection."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_21C9B140D767","assigned_cluster_id":"C1","justification":"Cooking large batches of reliable meals to last days is a claim about ease, cost and time-saving practicality."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_8787ADFE5BAB","assigned_cluster_id":"C17","justification":"The claim is that self-built habitual routines become entrenched defaults that resist change independently of outside pressure."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_F835CD4184D0","assigned_cluster_id":"C3","justification":"Meals are visibility/anonymity or loneliness clusters."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_8D2CED3DFCFA","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"The claim that individuals retain agency to connect despite few options fits none of the community clusters' specific assertions."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_1EA8715F4833","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"The claim that convenience coexists with cutting meat is a deliberative claim absent from the taxonomy, which treats meat as unexamined default."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_B71ED9DF7853","assigned_cluster_id":"C17","justification":"The theme's options."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_91DD1EFDCF67","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"Parenthood constraining friendship maintenance is a life-stage claim distinct from retirement comfort of habitual choices."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_0DEFBB646DF3","assigned_cluster_id":"C3","justification":"The claim is guilt-free in-the-moment flexibility, choosing whatever is enjoyable rather than following a rule."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_868E97BA4F16","assigned_cluster_id":"C1","justification":"Eating patterns are claimed to follow practical considerations and preference rather than principle or planning."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_6C9C0E72DF3A","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"The dispute over whether constrained or chosen community is more authentic does not map onto any single cluster's claim."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_43D0AFB1E329","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"Bereavement collapsing meal structure and forcing deliberate rebuilding differs in agent and cause from retirement, partner-reliance or loneliness claims."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_E35609B43814","assigned_cluster_id":"C11","justification":"It asserts that village familiarity does not automatically produce real community support, requiring effort instead."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_FDA56130F0E3","assigned_cluster_id":"UNCERTAIN","justification":"This claims meat eating is a consciously chosen preference, the opposite stance to the unquestioned-default cluster."},{"raw_theme_id":"RT_C8F87DCF4B63","assigned_cluster_id":"C3","justification":"Daily food decisions are claimed to shift with mood, tiredness and circumstance in the moment rather than a plan."}]}

{"decisions":[{"raw_theme_id":"RT_0085A1684032","assigned_cluster_id":"C5","justification":"Claims that entrenched routine, not available options, dictates unexamined default food/venue choices,
